description: This file defines the ExploreChartPanel React component for rendering and managing an interactive chart panel in the Superset frontend, including chart rendering, layout, state management, and user interactions.

classes.name: DefaultHeader
classes.description: Default React functional component used as a fallback header extension.

methods.name: updateQueryContext
methods.description: Fetches and updates the chart's query context if not already set.

methods.name: renderChart
methods.description: Renders the main chart container with current data and state.

methods.name: refreshCachedQuery
methods.description: Triggers a refetch of the chart data.

methods.name: onCollapseChange
methods.description: Handles collapsing or expanding the side panel.

methods.name: onDragEnd
methods.description: Updates layout sizes after drag-and-drop resize.
